question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**linking**" means connecting or joining two or more things. (जोड़ना)
 
• In the context of the passage, "linking" conveys the idea of establishing connections between different regions.
 
• The other options: "**dividing**," "**collecting**," and "**sharing**" do not accurately express the idea of creating connections across vast regions.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Historians have identified several silk routes, over land and by sea, knitting together vast regions of Asia, and linking__ Asia with Europe and northern Africa.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dividing (विभाजन)**: means separating or splitting into parts.
 
• **Collecting (संग्रहण करना)**: means to gather together in one place.
 
• **Sharing (बाँटना)**: means using or enjoying something jointly with others.
